findings.reason: §7 is gated on §6 and writes "each transition once" from classified pointer state, so an unmeasured classifier sends §7 to build on a station that never classifies.
findings.text: §6's done-when measures fold-equality, bytes-parsed and refold-on-rewrite, all of which `station_store.ingest_stream`/`_fold_stream` already implement, and it carries no measure at all for the section's one new mechanism, the classifier at :164 ("`recovery.classify_pointer` runs once per run whose inputs changed, and its liveness probe runs only where the pointer's `launcher_host` is this node") — a grep of `reckon/crew/station_store.py` for `classify_pointer` returns nothing and `tick()` calls only `ingest_pointer`, `ingest_stream` and `heartbeat`, so the node can close §6 green with classification never running

findings.reason: the measure is the node's gate, so the node either fails it (and §8 cannot close) or waives it while the follower goes on reading GPFS, which is the exact cost §8 exists to remove; the plan needs a stated decision that the checkpoint and history move into the store, or the follower keeps a declared crew-home read and the measure is rewritten to name the one path allowed.
findings.text: §8's measure is "a 60 s `strace -f -e trace=openat,stat,newfstatat` of a running subscriber names no path under the crew home", but the only crew-home surface the section retires is the watch record (:208, "not a watch record under the crew home"), while the follower's per-pane checkpoint and history stay under `runs.follower_dir()` — `follow_checkpoint.checkpoint_path` and `history_path` both return `runs.follower_dir(project) / …`, and `reckon/crew_follow_commands.py` reads them on the poll path (`follow_checkpoint.read` :738, `.exists` :1656, `read_history` :2113), so the follower keeps opening crew-home paths and the measure cannot pass
